id.description: The CatalogApp id this category was assigned to, e.g. 'pacman-aur:wings3d'.

category.description: The assigned label — an app category or a game genre, consistent with the app's contentType.

confidence.description: The LLM's own certainty in this category. A three-level enum rather than a numeric score — self-reported LLM probabilities are poorly calibrated, so a finer scale would only pretend to precision. 'low' entries are kept for auditability but never applied (see llmCategoryMap).

reason.description: Why the LLM assigned this category — for auditability.

model.description: The Gemini model that produced this entry, e.g. 'gemini-3.8-flash' — classify-llm rotates across models to spread the free tier's per-model daily quota, so quality can be audited per model.

title: Enrich: LLM classifications
description: LLM-assigned categories for apps the deterministic signals couldn't classify — checked last in pickCategoryLabel, just before the 'To Classify' fallback. Generated by `pnpm classify-llm` (Gemini API), committed and consumed at build time; never hand-edited.
